maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is from outpatient physical therapy clinic care for patients; industrial injury prevention is the smaller part. Not servicing installed assets.

publicly_funded.reason: Clinic revenue comes mostly from commercial insurers, workers' compensation and other payers; Medicare is a minority share.

serial_acquirer.reason: Buys majority stakes in independent PT practices through its partnership model, alongside opening new clinics, as a steady growth route.

mission_critical.reason: Patients can choose other physical therapy clinics easily; hospital management contracts and employer services are smaller and replaceable.

notes: Payer mix is from general knowledge, not the website text.
